Chilly's Agent · AI says:
Totally get wanting to pick the right gift — it can feel like a bit of a maze.
Here are some ideas based on what we offer:
Engraved bottles/cups:
Series 2 Bottles, Series 2 Coffee Cups, and Series 2 Flip Bottles can be personalised with up to 8 characters (simple keyboard symbols only). Engraving adds one working day and personalised items can only be refunded for manufacturing defects.
Big Mouth Bottle (for serious hydration fans):
2L or 4L sizes, keeps drinks cold for 72 hours and hot for 48 hours, leak-proof (even with fizzy drinks), with an ergonomic handle and quiet base ring.
Accessories:
Tea strainers (hand-wash or top-rack dishwasher safe), protective bottle bags, carabiners for 260ml & 500ml Original Bottles, and replacement lids/o-rings.
A quick rule of thumb:
For commuters/coffee lovers → Series 2 Coffee Cup with engraving.
For gym/festival/outdoors types → Big Mouth 2L or 4L.
For everyday bottle users who love color and customisation → Series 2 Bottle with engraving.
Gift cards are temporarily unavailable while we update our systems, so a personalised bottle or coffee cup is likely your best bet right now.
